title: Space Mod
description: Do you hate when you fall thought the void in the end and lose everything? This mod adds a space dimension below the end!
body:
This mod adds a new dimension: The Space Dimension.
You can access it by falling into void in the end or flying up to Y 1000 in the overworld
There are some biomes: Green Aspen Forest, Dark Aspen Forest, Sandy, Blueberry and Green Mushroom Islands, Vast and Colourful Stone Mines.
There you can find the Rocknite. There are 3 versions: the Rocknite (Neutral), the Evil Rocknite, and the Boss Rocknite. You can also find some variants of normal mobs (Ex: Space Zombie). From time to time, asteroids will fall from the sky, with an Evil Rocknite.
You can mine Spacenite (from Diamond tier up) and use it to craft OP pickaxes, but you need to fight a boss to get the Spacenite Upgrade, needed for those recipes.

**Do not update if you play on the same world!**

More things coming soon!
(Custom gamerules are a work in progress, so prepare for errors if you use them)
